p: holy portion of the land: Of all the land of Israel the Lord only requires this portion for the temple and for the priests for the city and for the prince.
suffice you: The prophet shows that the heads must be first reformed before any good order can be established among the people.
ephah: Ephah and Bath are the same quantity save that an Ephah is a dry measure and a Bath liquid, Le 5:11, 1Ki 5:11.
five and twenty shekels: That is, sixty shekels make a weight called Mina, for he joins these three parts to a Mina.
month: Which was Nisan containing part of March and part of April.
hin of oil for an ephah: Read Ex 29:40.
